response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), 'Unknown') ORDER BY hand;
